title: Alert acknowledgment and safe snooze timer management
description: Implement alerts/acknowledgment_manager.py allowing driver/user to acknowledge and temporarily snooze audio alerts without falsely marking the driver as alert or clearing persistent risk state.
acceptanceCriteria: Provides acknowledge_alert() action that mutes audio for a configured snooze window (e.g. 15-30s)
Acknowledgment does NOT reset underlying risk estimate or change state to NORMAL while eyes remain closed
If severe indicators continue past snooze duration, alert audio automatically re-engages
All acknowledgment events are logged with timestamps
Unit tests verify snooze timeout and re-trigger behavior

steps.details: Create alerts/acknowledgment_manager.py maintaining is_snoozed, snooze_until_time, and max_snooze_limit.

steps.description: Implement snooze logic and safety bounds
steps.details: Implement snooze(duration_seconds=20). Cap maximum snooze duration to 60s and reject excessive repeated snoozes during critical Stage 3 alert.
Implement check method verifying whether current audio is suppressed by active snooze or eligible to play.
Create tests/test_acknowledgment_manager.py verifying snooze duration expiry, Stage 3 overrides, and audit logging.

technicalNotes: Per PRD FR-05, acknowledgment must never trick the system into assuming the driver is awake.
Log every snooze request to prevent silent suppression.
